name: What are the common causes of water damage around windows in Pacifica?

mainEntity.name: What are the common causes of water damage around windows in Pacifica?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Pacifica, common causes of water damage around windows often relate to its coastal climate. This includes persistent fog and rain leading to deteriorated caulking and seals, allowing moisture intrusion. High winds can drive rain into subtle gaps. Poorly maintained or improperly installed flashing, clogged gutters, or inadequate roof overhangs are also frequent culprits. Timely maintenance and inspection are key to mitigating these risks in the local environment.
acceptedAnswer.description: In Pacifica, common causes include deteriorated caulking from fog/rain, high winds driving rain, and issues with flashing or gutters.
